title: Bezel Set Cabochon
weightNote: For the thin half-round shank. Working weight, until a finished ring is weighed.
stone: Cabochons, including ovals and less regular shapes. Faceted stones use the traditional bezel.
about: This setting holds a cabochon in a low bezel. A metal rim follows the outline of the stone and protects the edge. The ring stays low on the hand. The shape can follow an oval or a less regular cabochon.
The traditional bezel is the setting for faceted stones. This one is for cabochons.

points.name: Unique shapes.
points.text: The bezel follows the cabochon, so the stone does not have to be a standard round or oval.

points.name: Fully protected.
points.text: The metal rim covers the edge of the stone.

points.name: Low profile.
points.text: The setting stays low, so the ring wears close to the hand.

media.caption: Cantera opal, with decorative shoulders.

media.alt: An oval blue and green azurite cabochon in a low silver bezel, with decorative rings where the bezel meets the half-round shank.
media.caption: Azurite, with decorative shoulders.

media.alt: Two low silver bezel rings on dark wood, one with a red cabochon and one with a blue cabochon, both on plain half-round shanks.
media.caption: Plain half-round shanks. This is the baseline for the weight.

priceNote: Included is part of the sterling price: the half-round shank and plain shoulders. The price shown is the price at the time of the order. It follows the metal price.

choices.name: Half-round
choices.detail: Thin half-round band. The sterling weight is for this shank.

choices.name: Decorative
choices.detail: Stacked rings where the bezel meets the shank.

fingerSize: Finger size is required with every order. Ask for it when the setting is written down.
leadTime: The setting is made to order once the stone is chosen. Allow 2 weeks.
open: Weigh a finished silver ring with the thin half-round shank. It is 2.5 g for now.
Weigh the first gold ring to confirm the estimate.
